name: SMS.ru
description: SMS Framework gateway plugin that sends messages and reads delivery reports through the SMS.ru API.
project_description:
SMS.ru — module integrates with sms.ru API to send SMS messages.

 Contains API for developers to make requests to sms.ru API's. The module will integrate smsru core with SMS Framework 

 Features of SMS.ru module:

 
 Full support for an actual API of SMS.ru, including callcheck API . 
 
 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 The Drupal core only. No third party dependencies.

 Back to top 

 SUGGEST 
 SMS Framework 

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 
 composer require drupal/smsru - It's strongly recommended to lock version before stable realese will be released. 
 Install the SMS.ru module as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information. 
 
 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 There is no administration interface.
